What is Hiveworx

The things that shape your everyday life, finally understood from the inside.

Practitioners, not professors

Our mentors learned through curiosity, practice, mistakes and personal obsession, and they teach the same way they worked.

Learn by doing

Talks and lectures give you the story behind the work. Workshops, demonstrations and hands-on experiments let you try it with your own hands.

Open to anyone

Everyone is welcome, whatever your age or background. You don’t need previous education, a portfolio or any design experience.

Try new fields

Explore a discipline without long-term commitment. Discover new interests, hobbies or a possible career, and build confidence through doing.

what we left out

  • Traditional school
  • Diplomas & certificates
  • Academic status
  • Entry requirements

What you can study

Design in the widest sense.

Six fields, one approach: touch the material, try the process, understand the decisions behind it.

↗

Design Thinking

Observe, question, prototype and test. A way of solving problems you can use anywhere.

 ↗

Graphic Design

Typography, layout, print, visual identity and composition.

 ↗

Typography

From hand-made letters to digital tools. Create your own typeface.

 ↗

Sound + Visual

How sound and visuals connect to build identity, rhythm and atmosphere.

 ↗

Image + Word

Storytelling through photography, editing, light and time, and the words that go with them.

 ↗

Craft and Making

Shapes, materials, forms and textiles. Low-tech prototyping with your hands.

Philosophy

People learn deeply when they meet someone who has lived the process.

Get involved

What students get

The goal is not to graduate. Try new fields, see how design really works, and take something useful back into your life.
